generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Contractors should have civil contractor registration in KPWD/KUWSDB etc.

Assessed Available Tender capacity (AxNx5.0-B) should be greater than the ampount put to tender A equals to Maximum value of civil engineering works executed in any one year during the last five years taking into account the completed as well as works in progress. N equals to Number of years B equals to Value of On-going works
Form of Tender is mandatory to Upload in KPPP portal
The caste certificate and the Domocile certificate is mandatory to be uploaded in kppp-procurement portal
The rates considered in the tender are based on CSR & is exclusive of GST

Refer Annexure(A) enclosed along for jurisdictions of the courts and safety measures to be taken while executing the works as per letter No.BWSSB/EIC/CE(P)/0027/16-17 Dt.10.04.2017 & further here by informed to include the same in the contract agreement
Note: Road cutting machine should be used mandatorily for cutting the approved width of road while executing the work as per circular No.BWSSB/CH/CAO-s/CHI/138/19-20 Dt.04.09.2019

The tendere should have in the last 5 years period achieved in atleast one financial years an average annual financial turn over of rupees not less than the estimated cost i.e., Rs.25.75 lakhs.(Profit and loss Account, Balance sheet certified/Audited by chartered Accountant)
The tenderer should have satisfactorily completed as a prime contractor for atleast any construction work to an extent of 25% of the cost of the work i.e.,Rs.6.44 lakhs
All conditions are as per IFT and Bid Document

itemList.description: Dismantling of Flexible Pavements.Dismantling of Flexible pavements and disposal of dismantled materials and stacking serviceable and unserviceable materials separately.By Mechanical Means.Bituminous course

Earth work excavation for pipeline trenches in all kinds of soils by mechanical means as per drawing and technical specifications, including setting out, construction of shoring, strutting, barricading, caution lights, bracing, using sight rails & bonding rods at every 100 mm wherever necessary as directed, removal of stumps and other deleterious matter, dressing of sides and levelling the bottom of trench to the extent required , utilising the available excavated earth locally for the work etc., and all other appurtenances complete in the following strata.All kinds of soils. Depth upto 1.50 m
Depth exceeding 1.5m, but not exceeding 3 m

Providing lowering laying, jointing, testing and commissioning of following diameters glazed stone ware pipes, conforming to IS 651:1992, (with 5th revision) in all respects jointing with EPDM rubber rings (seals according to EN 681 & ASPM 425) The rubber seals joints pipe will have groves in interior of socket and exterior of the spigot. The rubber gasket shall be prefixed at the factory by the manufacturer rigidly with approved glue to have leak proof joint including conveying of pipe to work site and rolling and lowering into trenches, laying true to line, level and perfect linking at joints testing and commissoning including loading and unloading at both destinations and cuts of pipes wherever necessary including jointing of GSW pipes and specials, with rubber gaskets conforming to EN 681 and ASTM C-425 including cleaning the socket and spigot with soap solution and applying talcum powder for detecting crack, then applying glue and before inserting of rubber gaskets, jacking and fixing in perfect condition including the cost of soap solution, talcum powder and glue etc. and giving necessary hydraulic test to the required pressure of water head with all lead and lifts including costing of jointing materials and all necessary survey works for laying of sewers etc., and disposal of debris as directed etc., complete. (Contractor will make his own arrangements for procuring water for testing) with Rubber ring gasket joints.230 mm dia. pipes

Refilling available earth around trenches/pipelines, cables in layers not exceeding 20 cms in depth, compacting each deposited layer by ramming after watering with a lead upto 50 m, and lift upto 1.5 m. Including cost of all labour complete as per specifications

Dismantling the damaged or collapsed Machinehole ,conical in shape, and reconstructing the same for the same dimensions, with machine made wire cut brick in CM 1:4 with ordinary portland cement etc. as per design and specifications. The existing ring, cover and CC beeding to be used. For 1.2M dia.For Machinehole of 1.2M dia and 1.0 M depth
Providing, filling and laying of sand bags filled with sand / clay for diversion of sewage during execution of work
Dewatering the sewage / storm water by using reqired HP submersible pump for the diversion of storm / sewage during the execution of work. Considering for one Pump.5 hp pump
